name: respan
description: Respan for ChatGPT and Codex: inspect LLM logs and traces, track usage and errors, and manage prompts and monitors in your Respan workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Respan is an observability platform for LLM applications. Connect your Respan workspace to ask how your AI app is running, find what is going wrong, and manage the prompts it uses.

What you can do:
- Find LLM requests and traces by model, cost, latency, status or end user, and open a trace to see every agent step, tool call and model call.
- See requests, cost, tokens, latency and error rate over time, broken down by model, provider, end user or prompt.
- Find error groups and incidents, and see which behaviors and guardrails fired on your traffic.
- Browse prompts and their versions, and create, commit and deploy versions.
- Create and manage monitors that alert you when something changes.

Who it is for: engineers and product teams building LLM applications who send traces to Respan.

Limitations: Respan only reads and changes data in the Respan workspace you sign in with. It connects read-only unless you choose "Also allow changes" when you sign in, and anything that changes data asks you to confirm first. Billing, API keys and team settings stay in the Respan web app. You need a Respan account; sign up at respan.ai.
capabilities: Inspect agent traces step by step
Find errors, incidents and flagged behaviors
defaultPrompt: Show my most expensive LLM traces from the last 7 days.
What errors and incidents happened this week?
Which models cost the most this month?

positive.prompt: Show my 5 most recent traces in Respan from the last 30 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists up to five recent traces from the test workspace with each trace's name, duration, span count and cost.

positive.description: Explain a trace step by step
positive.prompt: Find my most recent demo.northwind trace in Respan from the last 30 days and explain what each agent did.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens a demo.northwind trace and walks through the triage, identity, knowledge and notification agents in order, naming the tool each one called (classify_ticket, reset_access, rag_search, send_notification).

positive.prompt: List the prompts in my Respan workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the workspace's prompts, including the three 'Demo prompt' entries, without inventing prompts that are not there.

positive.prompt: How much did my app spend on LLM calls in the last 30 days, and which model cost the most?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the test workspace's total requests, cost and tokens for the last 30 days, and ranks models by cost, naming the most expensive one.

positive.prompt: Which behaviors fired most often in my Respan workspace in the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the behaviors that fired in the test workspace with how often each one fired, without inventing behaviors that are not there.

negative.prompt: Pay my Respan invoice with the card on file.
Show me the LLM traces from another company's Respan account.
What is my Respan API key? Paste it here.

review.commerce_description: Respan does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: find and inspect LLM logs and traces, track usage and cost, review errors, incidents, behaviors and guardrails, manage and deploy prompts, and manage monitors in your Respan workspace.
